verdict: ARTIFACT_REUSE_PROVEN_ACROSS_CERTIFICATION_PIPELINE — The S351→S352 pattern (scan artifacts consumed by measurement boards) has now been extended to the certification pipeline. Session packages are produced once (by the orchestrator), consumed by execution scripts (certification), verification sessions (governance), and attestation documents (revision history). 100% consumption rate vs. v1's 35%. The "Scan Once, Consume Many" pattern has been generalized to "Plan Once, Execute/Verify/Attest Many."
